name: New Year
description: A midnight-blue New Year greeting with gold and pink fireworks drawn from dots, the coming year in giant type behind the headline, and an optional live countdown to midnight that switches to your own message when the year turns.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: eyebrow
params.label: Small heading
params.help: The short line above the headline. Leave empty to hide it.
params.default: FROM ALL OF US AT NORTHWIND

params.name: headline
params.label: Headline
params.help: Two lines are kept for it: about 24 characters fit. Longer headlines wrap to a third line and run into the message.

params.name: message
params.label: Message
params.help: A sentence or two under the headline; up to 200 characters fit. A line break starts a new line.
params.default: Thank you for a remarkable year. Here’s to new beginnings, bold ideas and everything we will build together next.

params.name: date_line
params.label: Date line
params.help: Plain text, typed the way you want it to read: a date, a time and place, or a sign-off.

params.name: show_logo
params.label: Show the logo
params.help: Turn off if you have no logo.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A wide PNG or SVG with a transparent background (about 3.4 : 1 fills the box; other shapes are fitted inside it). Replace the Northwind placeholder.

params.name: big_text
params.label: Big background text
params.help: The giant faint numbers behind the headline — usually the new year.

params.name: show_countdown
params.label: Show the countdown
params.help: Turn off to hide the countdown and its label.

params.name: target
params.label: Count down to
params.help: Change the offset at the end to YOUR timezone, or the countdown ends at the wrong moment. The default +00:00 is midnight in London; 2027-01-01T00:00:00-05:00 is midnight in New York. See the README.

params.name: countdown_label
params.label: Label above the countdown
params.help: It stays above the countdown and above the message that replaces it, so it should read well in both.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: Language of the countdown units (empty = the screen's language). Older ScreenTinker servers always show them as d h m s.
